# 【ERONOCTOSIS COLLAB with SHIORI】save us from madness in this pixel co-op horror 🐾 【FUWAMOCO】

## ⚡ Quick Stream Highlights (TL;DR)
- FUWAMOCO Ch. hololive-EN and Shiori Novella collaborated in the pixel co-op horror game Eronoctosis, navigating its challenging mechanics and persistent monsters.
- The stream was filled with strategic discussions, moments of panic, and humorous exchanges as FUWAMOCO Ch. hololive-EN and Shiori Novella worked together to survive.
- FUWAMOCO Ch. hololive-EN and Shiori Novella celebrated overcoming a major game objective, including completing a difficult DLC section.
- The stream concluded with FUWAMOCO Ch. hololive-EN reflecting on their long-awaited co-op gaming experience and sharing various promotional announcements.

## ⭐ Standout Stories & Timestamps
- **[⏱️ 00:07:56](#t=00:07:56) First Enemy Encounter & Strategy**: FUWAMOCO Ch. hololive-EN and Shiori Novella encounter their first 'deadbeat' enemy, collaboratively learning the combat mechanics using a flashlight and camera to defeat it.
- **[⏱️ 00:19:50](#t=00:19:50) Frustrating Lack of Progress Saves**: FUWAMOCO Ch. hololive-EN and Shiori Novella express dismay over the game's lack of progress saving, leading to repeated attempts at challenging sections and strategizing 'perfect runs'.
- **[⏱️ 00:35:45](#t=00:35:45) Trapped with No Way Back Panic**: After venturing into a mysterious 'hole', FUWAMOCO Ch. hololive-EN and Shiori Novella discover there's 'no way back', leading to a moment of frantic laughter and realization of being trapped.
- **[⏱️ 00:52:10](#t=00:52:10) Fatal Frame Comparison by FUWAMOCO Ch. hololive-EN**: One of FUWAMOCO Ch. hololive-EN jokingly compares the game's camera mechanics and enemy capturing to the survival horror series 'Fatal Frame', despite difficulty with the in-game camera.
- **[⏱️ 01:02:40](#t=01:02:40) Shiori Novella Addressed Amidst Chaos**: During a particularly intense enemy encounter, one of FUWAMOCO Ch. hololive-EN directly calls out to Shiori Novella, highlighting a moment of collaborative urgency.
- **[⏱️ 01:32:20](#t=01:32:20) A Player Gets 'Squished'**: During a frantic escape from game dangers, one of the players (from FUWAMOCO Ch. hololive-EN or Shiori Novella) dramatically exclaims 'I'm squished', signaling a close call or temporary defeat.
- **[⏱️ 01:44:30](#t=01:44:30) Emotional Game Objective Completion**: FUWAMOCO Ch. hololive-EN and Shiori Novella successfully complete a significant in-game objective, triggering a narrative about 'reunited siblings' and their bodies being restored, bringing a dramatic close to the challenge.
- **[⏱️ 02:05:00](#t=02:05:00) Long-Awaited Co-op Gaming Joy**: FUWAMOCO Ch. hololive-EN express deep satisfaction and joy about finally playing Eronoctosis together with Shiori Novella after a three-year wait, reminiscing about past shared gaming experiences.

## ⏱️ Timeline Breakdown
- **[⏱️ 00:00:16](#t=00:00:16) Game Title Pronunciation**: FUWAMOCO Ch. hololive-EN and Shiori Novella discuss the pronunciation of 'Eronoctosis' and whether it's a real word. The conversation shifts to favorite toast toppings before they begin exploring the pixel-art game's initial mechanics and visual 'crunchiness'.
- **[⏱️ 00:15:00](#t=00:15:00) Initial Strategy & Deaths**: FUWAMOCO Ch. hololive-EN and Shiori Novella grapple with game mechanics after an early death. They encounter 'magma' enemies, discover their weakness to light, and express frustration over the lack of progress saving, leading to role-switching and attempts at 'perfect runs'.
- **[⏱️ 00:30:00](#t=00:30:00) Flashlight Defense & Spawns**: FUWAMOCO Ch. hololive-EN and Shiori Novella navigate a dark environment, using flashlights to defend against 'green monsters'. They strategize against 'big guys' and 'smaller ones', realizing monsters 'spawn all at once'. They enter a mysterious 'hole' only to find 'no way back'.
- **[⏱️ 00:45:02](#t=00:45:02) Treasure Collection & DLC**: FUWAMOCO Ch. hololive-EN and Shiori Novella focus on using the camera to defeat monsters and collect 'treasures' like 'mouth,' 'thighs,' and 'eyeballs.' After encountering dead ends, they decide to explore a DLC area, immediately facing new monsters and environmental hazards like 'holes on the ground'.
- **[⏱️ 01:00:01](#t=01:00:01) Labyrinth Navigation & FNAF**: FUWAMOCO Ch. hololive-EN and Shiori Novella navigate a labyrinthine area, fighting 'squishies' and a 'big one'. They get lost, find shortcuts, and compare the game's tension to 'FNAF'. They discuss item collection goals and debate whether to tackle a 'DLC' or 'easiest' area to 'warm up'.
- **[⏱️ 01:15:00](#t=01:15:00) Navigational Confusion & Panic**: FUWAMOCO Ch. hololive-EN and Shiori Novella struggle with navigation in a dark, pillar-filled environment, debating speedrunning or using a walkthrough. They encounter 'squishies' and 'tentacles', fleeing from fast, teleporting enemies, and discover a 'dangerous secret path' filled with more threats.
- **[⏱️ 01:30:00](#t=01:30:00) Parkour Area Challenges**: FUWAMOCO Ch. hololive-EN and Shiori Novella enter a challenging 'parkour area', facing 'little guys', 'big ones', and 'squishies'. They experience close calls, including one player being 'squished', and share humorous directional confusion. The segment culminates in completing an objective about 'reunited siblings'.
- **[⏱️ 01:45:01](#t=01:45:01) Lore Reveal & Part Two**: FUWAMOCO Ch. hololive-EN and Shiori Novella overcome an intense encounter, leading to a significant lore reveal where a character expresses gratitude for being 'whole again'. They then transition to a confusing 'Part Two' of the level, struggling with navigation and treasure management while fending off monsters.
- **[⏱️ 02:00:00](#t=02:00:00) Game Completion & Promos**: FUWAMOCO Ch. hololive-EN and Shiori Novella successfully complete a challenging section on their first attempt, then discuss game modes and an 'easy mode'. They reflect on their three-year wait to play together and make promotional announcements for a new song cover, merchandise, a 3D live concert, and an upcoming lore video and 'advent collab' involving gnomes.
